'''Askaj''', also called '''Askaji''', was the [[Homeworld/Legends|home planet]] of the [[Askajian/Legends|Askajians]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], far off the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] had one [[Moon/Legends|moon]], the [[Moon Lady]], whom the people worshiped as a [[Deity/Legends|deity]].

==Society==
There was no form of central government on Askaj, but rather tribal societies. Technology was not very advanced on the planet, compared to other parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

[[Tomuon]] were central to the lives of the Askajians who used them for food, shelter, fabric, and other items.

==History==
The planet was under the administration of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilkadon]], whose oppression provoked many Askajians to relocate to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref> Sometime after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the planet was liberated by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2011]] ''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' was the first [[Star Wars Legends]] source to list the planet as ''"Askaji"'', as it is now known by in [[canon]].
